input.quote: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: Section 7 is headed "Indemnification of Contractor" but its three subsections contain only a liability cap, a consequential-damages waiver and an attorneys'-fees waiver; a document-wide search for indemnity/hold harmless/defence language returns no operative indemnity in either direction. Section 5(c) gives a non-infringement warranty of the Works but no defence or indemnity, and the Section 7(a) cap (fees paid, save for a stray "Paragraph 9" carve-out to the Independent Contractor clause) would limit any recovery. Absence of any Vendor IP indemnity is walk-away territory, so we insert the fallback: a Contractor IP indemnity for the Services and Works with the customary Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a 3x annual fees super-cap carved out of the Section 7(a) cap. No Customer indemnity exists to narrow, so we do not introduce one.

proposal.summary: Add Contractor IP indemnity with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 is headed "Indemnification of Contractor" but contains no indemnity language at all, leaving us with no protection against third-party IP claims. We add a Contractor IP indemnity with the customary Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a 3x annual fees super-cap carved out of the Section 7(a) cap, which is our fallback position.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF
ops.newText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF AND SECTION 7(d)

ops.text: Contractor shall indemnify Company against any third-party claim alleging that the Services or the Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from (i) modification of the Works by Company, (ii) combination of the Works by Company with items not supplied by Contractor, or (iii) Contractor's compliance with specifications furnished by Company. Contractor shall, at its option, procure for Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, refund the fees paid to Contractor for the affected item. Contractor's liability under this Section 7(d) shall not exceed three times (3x) the annual fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
